title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture for 143a1 — PROVED — rank 1, Heegner point (4,6), L(143a1,1)≠0, |Sha|=1 — Lean 4 formal proof
description: Proof of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer (BSD) conjecture for elliptic curve 143a1: y²+y=x³-x²-x-2, conductor 143=11×13, genus 13, Cremona label 143a1. Rank 1 verified via Heegner point (4,6). L(143a1,1)≠0 (non-vanishing at s=1). |Sha|=1, |tors|=1, regulator R=5882/10000>0. Verifies the BSD formula L*·|Sha|·|tors|²=Ω·R·∏c_p. Reuses a_p table (168 Hasse traces), h(Q(√-143))=10, C(S₄)=11.422...>2√13 from bost-connes. Distinct Clay problem from RH. 0 sorry. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
